clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding materials,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding materials, dimensions, manufacture and finish of mild steel sliding door bolts commonly used in general building constrcution for locking doors, gates, etc, with padlocks.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types i) Plate Type, and ii) Clip or bolt type.

clauses.title: Sizes
clauses.text: 3. Sizes (a) Plate type sliding bolts— 150, 200,  250, 300, 375 and 450 mm; and (b)Clip or bolt type sliding bolts— 200, 250,   300, 375 and 450 mm

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 4. Materials Mild Steel Mild Steel Wire Mild Steel Rod Note— For details of material see 5 of the standard.

clauses.title: Sizes
clauses.text: 5. Sizes a) Plate type sliding bolts — 150,  200, 250,   300, 375 and 450 mm. b) Clip or bolt type sliding bolts - 200, 250, 300, 375 and 450 mm

clauses.title: Tolerances–Length of bolt -
clauses.text: 5.1 Tolerances-Length of bolt - Sizes up to and including 300 mm  ±  2 mm Sizes 375 mm and  450 mm               ±  3 mm Note—  Size represents length of the bolt. For detailed dimensions and tolerances see 6 of  the standard.

clauses.title: Finish–
clauses.text: 6. Finish- i) Sliding Bolts, Plate Type - Back plate straps and staple plate shall be stove enamalled black before assmebling. Hasp and bolt shall be finished bright or copper-oxidized or shall be plated with nickel or chromium. ii) Sliding Bolts, Clip or Bolt Type — Hasp, bolt, staple and clips or fixing bolts shall  be copper oxidized or shall be plated with  nickel or chromium . Note—When the sliding bolts is to be finished bright, a thin coating of rust preventive shall  be given. For detailed information, refer to IS  281 : 1991 Specification for mild steel sliding door bolt  for use with padlocks  (third revision). SUMMARY OF IS 281 : 1991 MILD STEEL SLIDING DOOR BOLTS FOR USE WITH PADLOCKS (Third Revision)
